description:
We are Rokt. We are the global leader in ecommerce, on a mission to make every transaction more relevant. We’ve built our business around the Transaction Moment™, the span from cart to confirmation where customer attention and intent peak, and where more than 90% of a business's ancillary revenue potential sits untapped.
 The Rokt Brain leverages advanced machine learning to determine the next best action for every customer in real time across the Rokt Network, powering 13 billion transactions a year for brands like: Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Albertsons and more. Since 2012 we've grown from a Sydney startup, to a $3.5B company with 700+ Rokt'stars across eight offices and 15 markets, sustaining a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 40%+ for over a decade.

 At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation , which is why we have a well-defined career ladder with clear compensation and career paths based on competency and ability. 

Compensation for this role is $40/hour. In addition, you will receive a generous technology allowance to spend on a Macbook Pro M5 + accessories: yours to keep. 
 If you secure a full-time offer post-residency, total target compensation ranges will be $90,000 - $136,000, including a fixed annual salary of $85,000 - $125,000, employee equity plan grant (RSUs), and world-class benefits.
 This is the expected range for the role. Final compensation is determined by the level assessed through the interview and residency process and based on how your experience and skills map to our career ladder.
 About the role
 The Rokt Residency is a 18 week, full-time, paid early-career program for AI Operations Associates working out of our office in New York City.

This cohort of residencies will run from January 12, 2027 through to May 14, 2027. 
 Residents will have the opportunity to receive full-time offers to join Rokt on or before the completion of their residency. 
 We are an AI-first company. We’re a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and “someone should build a tool for that” is treated as a volunteer sign-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn’t obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won’t like it here.
 
 How your future team uses AI 
Rokt Operations teams use AI to streamline repetitive tasks, analyze data, identify process gaps, draft and improve documentation, QA workflows, surface insights, and automate manual handoffs. We expect team members to be curious, resourceful, and comfortable experimenting with AI tools from day one so we can build processes that scale without adding unnecessary complexity.
 How you will contribute 
 Streamline & automate workflows: Identify inefficiencies across launch, QA, monitoring, troubleshooting, approvals, and operational processes. Design and implement AI-enabled automations that reduce time and errors.
 Build internal tools: Create and deploy tools that improve decision-making, increase visibility, and remove bottlenecks.
 Improve speed + quality outcomes: Measure the impact of what you ship, iterate quickly, and help drive improvements against goals.
 Collaborate with stakeholders: Partner closely with other teams to understand pain points, align on outcomes, and land changes that stick.
 Get trained at speed: Learn the ins and outs of Rokt’s platform and internal tools through hands-on work, then use that context to accelerate via automation and better systems.
 Requirements 
 Who You Are
 Analytical & resourceful: You dive into unknown areas head first, use data to drive decisions, and break problems down to first principles.
 AI Fluency: Given a manual problem, you can identify the right tools and approaches, generate a quality output, and automate the process along the way.
 Self-starter with ownership: You take ideas from concept to implementation. When you spot a problem, you build toward a solution and own the outcome.
 Adaptable & resilient: You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You iterate quickly when something doesn’t work.
 Collaborative communicator: You work well with diverse teams and can explain complex ideas simply. You handle feedback with humility and can bring others along.
 Availability to work full time, in the office in New York, for the full 4 calendar months
 Benefits 
 About Rokt’stars:
 We move fast and decide with incomplete information, because a good decision this week can lead to a perfect one next quarter. We work as one team, which means the best idea wins regardless of who raised it or what level they are. We hire people who are brilliant and humble and who are obsessed with making the customer successful.
 Benefits from Day One
 Every resident has enterprise access to leading AI tools with generous usage limits, building AI fluency as a core skill. 
 Catered lunch every day and a fully stocked pantry
 Dog-friendly offices so you can bring your best friend to work
 Generous Required Technology Allowance
 
 Permanent employment benefits:
 Fully funded insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision)
 Dollar-for-dollar 401K matching plan (up to 4% of fixed annual salary)
 Fully funded life, short term, and long term disability insurance
 Equity in a profitable, fast-growing company approaching $1 Billion in revenue
 Monthly Wellness and Cell Phone Allowances
 Quarterly performance reviews for most roles, so feedback and promotion decisions don’t wait
 Extra leave (bonus annual leave, sabbatical leave etc.)
 Work in the office with your team at least 4 days a week, because we believe we are better together.
 
 At Rokt, we choose to create a company that is as diverse and inclusive as the world we live in by attracting, growing and keeping the best talent. Equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
 If this sounds like a role you’d enjoy, apply here, and you’ll hear from our recruiting team.
 Rokt only contacts candidates from @rokt.com addresses. We never request payment, bank details, or identity documents before a written offer, and we never interview solely over chat apps. Verify any role at rokt.com/careers if you’re unsure.
 Note: The first stage of the recruitment process for this role is to complete a 15-minute online aptitude test, which will be sent out to your application email. Successful candidates will be contacted to discuss next steps.
